text: The McCormick and Bill Bolton Arena Nominating Panel must select candidates for interview to fill three vacancies on the Bill Bolton Arena Board. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its February 7, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to Toronto and East York Community Council.

The McCormick and Bill Bolton Arena Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its February 7, 2018 meeting for appointment to the Bill Bolton Arena Board: Candidate # 16 Candidate # 28 Candidate # 34 Candidate # 36 Candidate # 37 Candidate #51 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 23, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Bill Bolton Arena Board.
